press_references.value: Sentry’s Seer Agent lets developers debug production issues in natural language

product_launches.description: Sentry launched Seer Agent, a natural-language debugging agent that lets developers query across their full observability stack to investigate production issues, now available in open beta to customers using Seer.

press_references.value: Sentry Adds Local Development and Code Review Debugging to Seer

product_launches.description: Sentry launched new capabilities for its AI-powered debugging agent Seer, adding support for local development and code review debugging, and making the product generally available with a new flat pricing model.

press_references.value: From observability to reasoning: How AI agents are catching bugs before they ship

product_launches.description: Sentry introduced Seer, a new AI-powered reasoning layer that uses production error data and telemetry to find root causes, suggest fixes, and proactively prevent bugs from shipping.

press_references.value: Sentry Announces AI Code Review: With New AI-Powered Feature, Developers Can Now Stop Bugs Before They Reach Production

product_launches.description: Sentry launched AI code review in beta for GitHub, an AI-powered feature that predicts errors, reviews pull requests, and auto-generates unit tests to prevent bugs before production.

press_references.value: Sentry Launches Monitoring Tool for MCP Servers

product_launches.description: Sentry has launched MCP Server Monitoring, a new tool that provides developers with enhanced visibility and debugging capabilities for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. This product aims to help developers identify and resolve issues in MCP servers more efficiently, supporting the growing adoption of MCP in AI-compatible products.

overview_description.description: Sentry is an open-source platform for workflow productivity, aggregating data from errors and crashes across the stack. The company's tool shows every crash in the stack as it happens, with the details needed to prioritize and identify it, as well as offers insight into deployments and information to reproduce and fix crashes, enabling users to see which errors are doing the most harm to their business and helps them to understand how issues affect their bottom line.

about_short_description.short_description: Sentry is a developer of an application monitoring platform that helps developers optimize the performance of their code.

product.name: Sentry Application Monitoring Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for detecting, diagnosing, and resolving application errors and performance problems across web, mobile, and backend software.

product.name: Sentry Session Replay
product.description: A frontend and mobile diagnostic tool that records user sessions to help developers reproduce errors, investigate performance problems, and understand user interactions.

product.name: Sentry Profiling
product.description: A code-level profiling service for identifying CPU, memory, and function-level performance problems in backend, frontend, and mobile applications.

product.name: Seer
product.description: An AI-powered debugging and code-review service that analyzes Sentry issues, explains likely causes, and can propose or initiate fixes in a development workflow.

product.name: Codecov
product.description: A code coverage and test analytics platform that reports test coverage, analyzes coverage changes, and helps teams identify unreliable or failing tests in pull requests.

product.name: Answers by Sentry
product.description: A developer knowledge service that provides explanations of programming and application-development concepts to help users understand and prevent recurring technical problems.
